heading: EXT. THE LAST BRIDGE OF STARLIGHT, CLOUD CROSSING - TWILIGHT

units.text: EXT. THE LAST BRIDGE OF STARLIGHT, CLOUD CROSSING - TWILIGHT
A bridge of braided silver woven across a gulf of clouds.
Far below, a sea of mist rolls over unseen mountains.
Above, the first stars wink into a violet sky.
At the midpoint of the span stands a gate of white stone, and before the gate waits a figure in a robe the color of fog.
WARDEN ISAURA MENDELSSOHN-OKAFOR (ageless, silver hair to her waist) rests both hands on a staff of pale wood.
She does not move, though the wind tugs at her robe.

Two travelers approach along the bridge from the west: SIR BALTHAZAR OYELARAN-STIRLING (50s, battered plate armor, a laugh lurking behind a grim mouth), who limps, and a young mage, FENELLA CROSSLEY-AKINTOLA (20s, ink-stained sleeves, a spellbook the size of a paving stone), who walks backward half the time to check on him.
They stop ten paces from the gate.
Travelers. State your purpose.
units.name: ISAURA

units.text: We seek passage to the east, Warden.
units.name: BALTHAZAR

units.text: Not passage, exactly, it's more of a delivery --
units.name: FENELLA

units.text: Fenella --
units.name: BALTHAZAR

units.text: -- we have a message for the Moon Queen, you see, it's rather urgent --
units.name: FENELLA

units.text: The Queen receives no messages.
units.name: ISAURA

units.text: Not even this one?
units.name: FENELLA

units.text: Especially this one.
units.name: BALTHAZAR

units.text: You're not helping.
units.name: FENELLA

units.text: I'm helping a great deal.
units.name: BALTHAZAR

units.text: Isaura taps her staff once on the silver.
A clear note rings out across the gulf.
The clouds below shiver, the stars overhead pulse, and the gate swings inward a hand's breadth before stopping.
Three questions. Answer truly, and the gate opens. Answer falsely, and the bridge forgets you.
units.name: ISAURA

units.text: Forgets us?
units.name: FENELLA

units.text: It means we fall.
units.name: BALTHAZAR

units.text: I know what it means!
units.name: FENELLA

units.text: First question. What do you carry?
units.name: ISAURA

units.text: A letter and a debt.
units.name: BALTHAZAR

units.text: A spellbook and an apology.
units.name: FENELLA

units.text: Second question. Whom do you fear?
units.name: ISAURA

units.text: The Queen.
units.name: FENELLA

units.text: Myself.
units.name: BALTHAZAR

units.text: Isaura's face does not change.
But the staff trembles in her grip, ever so slightly.
Third question. What do you hope for?
units.name: ISAURA

units.text: Balthazar looks at Fenella.
Fenella looks at Balthazar.
A long silence stretches across the bridge, long enough for the first moon to rise, a pale silver coin over the clouds.
That she reads it.
units.name: BALTHAZAR

units.text: That she forgives it.
units.name: FENELLA

units.text: The gate opens fully.
Isaura steps aside and bows her head, and the three of them stand in the starlight, the only people in the world.
Pass, then. And be kind to her.
units.name: ISAURA
